scripts.comment_building: Build scripts optimized for production deployment
scripts.build: npm run build:clean && npm run build:server && npm run build:client && npm run build:copy
scripts.build:copy: npm run copy:client && npm run copy:assets
scripts.copy:assets: mkdir -p dist && cp -r uploads dist/ 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.reinstall: npm run clean && npm install && cd client && npm install
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && cd client && npm run typecheck

comment_explanation.build_process: The build script follows a logical sequence: clean previous builds, compile server TypeScript, build client React app, then copy all necessary files to the dist directory
comment_explanation.script_organization: Scripts are grouped by purpose with comments for clarity. The underscore prefix on comment keys ensures they don't interfere with npm's script running
comment_explanation.render_compatibility: The render:build and render:start scripts provide clear entry points for Render's deployment process
comment_explanation.dependency_separation: Production dependencies are separated from development dependencies to reduce final bundle size and deployment time
comment_explanation.postinstall_hook: The postinstall script ensures client dependencies are installed automatically when the main package is installed, crucial for Render's build process
